summary.tldr: Changes the Greenhouse Gas Pollution Pricing Act to expand farm equipment exemptions and add marketable natural gas and propane to qualifying farm fuel.
what_it_does: Expands eligible farming machinery to include property used to heat or cool buildings or similar structures used to raise livestock or grow crops.
Adds marketable natural gas and propane to the definition of qualifying farming fuel.
Delays some of those changes until the 8th anniversary of the Act coming into force, unless both Houses of Parliament approve a postponement.
Allows that postponement to be extended again through the same parliamentary process.
